gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Noto Kufi Arabic is modern and tidy, with a welcoming gap in its c. Press Start 2P brings the retro fun up top, so you can nudge the body size up or down freely while the pixel heading stays put.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans: Noto Sans reads contemporary and quietly sturdy, its lowercase filling most of the line. Press Start 2P gives the pair its strongest quality: a playful retro heading whose cut-out spacing is easy to enjoy beside such an easygoing partner.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Noto Sans Adlam keeps its curve endings well apart, and its c, s and z stand tall and full. Press Start 2P adds the retro fun on top.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-adlam-un: Pixel-game fun meets a polished modern sans. Press Start 2P spaces its letters like cut-outs, and Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined answers with generous gaps between curve ends and stems, plus little height difference between cases.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-anatolia: Press Start 2P spaces its letters like cut-out shapes pinned far apart, with big open-looking lowercase bowls and a retro grin. Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs keeps outward-pointing tips beneath it.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Letters pinned far apart like cut-outs give Press Start 2P its retro charm. It does the fun, attention-grabbing work up top, while Noto Sans Arabic handles the quieter job with wide openings on small letters and a pronounced x-height.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Playful and retro, Press Start 2P brings big open-looking lowercase bowls and widely spaced letters. And Noto Sans Avestan, a plain sans with a pronounced x-height, gives that energy a modern, tidy counterweight that really defines the pair.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-balinese: Press Start 2P pins its cut-out letters far apart, with big open-looking lowercase bowls and a retro wink. Noto Sans Balinese, a plain sans with breathing space inside every curve, gives the pair its strongest quality: playful up top, polished below.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Press Start 2P is fun and retro, with widely spaced cut-out letters. And Noto Sans Bamum, a plain sans with big open counters in every small letter, would keep a long passage feeling modern and easy.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-bassa-va: Noto Sans Bassa Vah has a dominant midsection and an open-jawed c, a plain sans that feels professional and contemporary. Press Start 2P adds a playful retro streak.
